subject: [LAZY CONSENSUS] Human Summary section in agent-drafted PR descriptions

messages.subject: [LAZY CONSENSUS] Human Summary section in agent-drafted PR descriptions
messages.body:
Hello everyone,

Following Shahar's idea - and a number of PRs he has already opened this
way - I would like to call for lazy consensus on making it a rule for
agent-drafted PR descriptions:

https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/73660

The idea is simple:

* A PR description drafted by an AI agent starts with a short "Human
  Summary" - a few sentences typed by the human author, in their own
  words: why the change is needed, key decisions, caveats.
* The agent-written description is still there, but below it, in an
  "AI Summary" section that is folded by default.
* Agents are instructed to ask the user for the Human Summary and paste
  it verbatim - they must never write, suggest or paraphrase it
  themselves.

This should make it much easier (not with 100% certainty, but quite
reliably) to tell PRs where a human understood and owns the change
apart from fully AI-generated ones. It also gives reviewers a quick,
human-level "why" before they dive into the details.

The PR only changes the guidance our agents follow (AGENTS.md and the
PR drafting/publishing skills) plus one bullet in the Gen-AI section of
contributing-docs. The regular PR template is unchanged - PRs created by
humans without agents are not affected. The PR itself is "dog-fed" - it
uses the new format.

As this is straightforward and uncontroversial, I plan to merge the PR
before the lazy consensus ends. If there are objections, we can simply
revert it.

The lazy consensus will end on Monday, 28 September 2026, 15:00 CEST,
unless there are objections.

J.

---------------------------------------------------------------------

messages.subject:
Re: [LAZY CONSENSUS] Human Summary section in agent-drafted PR
 descriptions
messages.body:
No.

-1 as it stands.

The PR description should already be for humans only. The PR description is the way the person opening the PR engages with the community, and being a meat proxy shows they don’t care about the consumers of it. Your proposal is reversing the priority to my mind

I.e. I think we should remove the `Human Summary ` and `AI Summary` headers, and use `<details><summary>AI Summary</summary>` instead of “click here”. 

Additionally: why did you merge this PR just 30mins after sending this email when the date below says “in 4 days”?

-ash

messages.subject: Re: [LAZY CONSENSUS] Human Summary section in agent-drafted PR descriptions
messages.body:
Sorr. I merged it because I **thought** it was non-controversial (I have
not seen any complaints about it before) - and yeah - I wrote that if there
will be any complaints I will revert it.

I am going to do now, and start a discussion as apparently it is apparently
controversial.  I do not agree with your arguments - I think it's exact
opposite of what you imply - and it's "centaur and not reverse centaur [1]
(or meat proxy)" - where human is in control.

BTW. I highly recommend the book "Reverse - author of the
"Entshittification" term. The book "The Reverse Centaur's Guide to Life
After AI" is a fantastic book, I literally swallowed it and it opened my
eyes to many things.

[1]
https://doctorow.medium.com/https-pluralistic-net-2025-09-11-vulgar-thatcherism-there-is-an-alternative-f1428b42a8fd



J
